title: Overview — the status of your page at a glance
body:
The **„Áttekintés”** page is the home screen of the dashboard: here you can see at a glance what
state your page is in, and what your next task is.

![Screenshot: the Overview page on a phone](assets/hu/screen.png)

## How the dashboard is laid out

- **On a computer**, the menu on the left shows the pages grouped together: **„Az oldalam”** (Texts,
  Photos, Availability, Modules), **„Vendégek”** (Bookings, Messages), **„Üzlet”** (Web address, Traffic,
  Documents, Wallet) and **„Fiók”** (Account, Help). Next to Photos and Modules you see the count, and next to Messages
  the number of unread ones. The list that drops down under **„Modulok”** lists the modules you can set up —
  clicking a name opens the settings of that module. With the arrow at the top of the menu, the menu can be
  collapsed into a narrow strip of icons, and it stays that way until you open it again.
- **On a phone**, the bottom bar has four main items (**„Áttekintés”**, **„Fotók”**, **„Foglalások”**,
  **„Üzenetek”**), and the fifth, **„Menü”**, opens the full list in a drawer on the left —
  with the same groups, and the **„Kilépés”** button at the bottom.
- **At the top of every page** there is a ← button and the path (for example “Boróka ház › Fotók”): both the arrow and the
  name of the accommodation take you back to the Overview, and your browser’s own Back button also works.
  On the right, the **„Oldal”** button opens in a new tab what your guests see.
- **Light or dark mode:** on a computer, the sun/moon button in the header and at the bottom of the menu, on a phone the
  **„Sötét mód”** / **„Világos mód”** row in the Menu switches it; your device remembers your choice.

## The setup bar — what is still missing?

At the very top of the Overview, a blue bar shows how many topics of your website setup are done (for example
“Setup: 5 / 12 topics done”), and what comes next. The **„Folytatom”** button takes you to where you
left off the setup. When everything is done, the bar turns paler, and with the **„Beállítás átnézése”** button
you can go through any topic again.

Below it, a box lists which modules are still waiting to be set up — every name is a button that takes you
to its questions —, and tells you in one sentence what the guest sees today (for example that they request a quote,
because there is no price). The **„Modulok”** button takes you to the Modules tab, where every topic is shown as a card. How
the setup works is described in the Help article “Setting up your website step by step”.

## What do the tiles show?

Below the setup bar there are three tiles:

- **„Állapot”** — the current status of your page, with the page’s address below it. “Előnézet (még nem
  publikus)” means that the page is ready, but for now only you can see it at a private address;
  “Élő (publikus)” means that anyone can find it on the internet. Clicking the address opens your
  page (the live address, or, until it goes live, the private preview). The “…” in the corner of the tile takes you to the
  Web address page.
- **„Látogatók · 7 nap”** — how many different people opened your page over the past week
  (**„egyedi látogató, robotok nélkül”**: we do not count search engine robots). The small bar row shows the
  days of the week; the “…” takes you to the Traffic page, where the detailed report is.
- **„Üzenetek”** — the three most recent messages sent to you; the dot at the start of a row marks the
  unread ones. Tapping a row opens the message; the “…” takes you to the Messages page.

## The cover image

Below the tiles, the **cover image indicator** shows the image a guest sees at the top of the page —
in its corner it says whether this is a **„Bemutató nyitókép”** or a **„Saját nyitókép”**, and how many
images you have in total. The **„Fotók kezelése”** button takes you to the Photos page — if you like, you can upload your own
images there. **„Nagyítás”** shows the image in full screen.

## Subscription card

On a computer at the bottom of the menu, and on a phone at the bottom of the Overview, a small card shows your subscription:
**„Éves előfizetés”** or **„Havi előfizetés”**, the renewal date, how many modules are active, and for an annual
plan, which of the 12 months you are in (the 12 small segments draw this out). The
**„Modulok kezelése”** button takes you to the Modules page, where the detailed invoice and the modules are.

## The “Tasks” list

The header of the list tells you how many **open** tasks you have, and on the right how many modules are
working on your page — the same number that the “module active” row of the subscription card and the
Modules page also give. A module that has been replaced (for example “Time slot request” when “Online booking”
takes its place) does not appear on the page, so it is not counted here. If a working
module does not have a separate price (because it is part of the base fee, or because you cancelled it, and it still
runs until the end of the paid period), the header also notes how many of these are **billed** (for example
“11 modul · 10 számlázott”). The two numbers are not a contradiction: the first tells you what is working on
your page, the second why you are paying. You see the combined fee on the Modules page, in the summary at the bottom of the **„Az én
moduljaim”** list; and the itemised breakdown in the **„A következő számla tételei”** expander of the
**„Előfizetés”** box.

The list updates by itself: the green dot and the struck-through text show that a step is done, the
dashed circle that it is still to come. At the right edge of each row is the name of the page where you can
take care of the task — tapping it takes you there. The Tasks list contains the items that are not about setting up a
module: booking requests waiting for a reply, settling the fee, putting the page live, the trial. Anything about
setting up a module — the introduction text, an empty module, a missing price — has moved to the setup bar
and to the cards on the Modules tab.

Once the introduction text is done, and your plan is in order, Citoviso puts the page live — you have no
separate task for this. A photo of your own is not a condition for going live: if you like, you can upload your own
images on the Photos page at any time.

## If a module is empty, or a room has no price

There are modules that appear to guests only when you fill them with content:
while it is empty, the section **does not go onto the page at all**. In that case its card is red, and it says:
“Empty — this section doesn't appear on the page for now”. It can occur with five modules: **Prices,
seasons**; **Weekly programme recommendations**; **Opening hours, arrival**; **What you offer (amenities)**;
**Rooms, apartments**.

The Prices card counts room by room: for example “1/3 rooms have a price”. For the rooms without a price the guest
sees no total, and requests a quote instead of booking. If you deliberately do not give a price for a room,
because you always send a custom quote, tick this at the question: “No price for this one”.
This is not a gap: the card then says **„Ön döntött így”**, and we send no reminder about it either.

## Free trial — the bar at the top of the page

While you are using your page in a free trial, a thin bar **at the top of every page** shows how long the
trial still lasts: how many days are left, and until which day (for example “until Oct 22, 2026 (Thursday)”). The bar cannot be
closed — do not lose sight of the end of the trial. The bar also states what happens at the end of the trial:
**„A próba végén a honlap szünetel, amíg nem rendeli meg.”** If you also received a discount with the trial, and it is still valid,
the bar states what percentage you get off the first fee if you order by the end of the trial.

- **3 days before the end**, the bar turns yellow. On the second-to-last day it says “expires tomorrow”, and on the last day
  it reads **„Ma jár le az ingyenes próba.”**
- With the **„Megrendelem”** button you reach the preview of your own page, with the order panel beside it: here you choose
  which modules to keep, and pay (the discount received with the trial is already counted in). We did not ask for a card during the
  trial, and we do not charge anything automatically either. If you decide not to pay now, the browser’s Back button
  takes you back to the dashboard.
- **On a phone**, the progress bar is dropped, and the button spans the full width of the bar.
- If the last day of the trial has already passed, but the page has not yet stopped (this happens at 7 a.m.), the bar
  reads **„Az ingyenes próba lejárt.”**
- Once you have paid, the bar disappears — from then on, the **Előfizetés** card on the **Modulok** tab shows the fee
  and the renewal date.

### The trial has expired — the page is paused

If you did not continue after the end of the trial, your page is **paused**: visitors get a courteous page with the accommodation’s
name, town and your contact details, so that they can reach you directly with a booking question.
Your dashboard, however, is live — you can still work in it now.

In this case, a red box sits at the top of every page, with the last day of the trial in its title: your page is paused because the trial has expired. On the Overview,
in it you see the discount received with the trial (if there was one), the **„Megrendelem — fizetés”** button, and the
**„Mi maradt meg”** list: your editor interface, all texts, images and settings, and the messages received.
These **do not stay forever**: we keep them for 90 days from the last day of the trial (Terms 1.4), and below the list
is the day on which we permanently delete them. At least a week before deletion we also notify you by email (with the subject “we will delete the trial page’s data in … days”) — if you
continue before then, nothing is deleted.
With the **„Megnézem, mit lát a látogató”** link at the bottom of the box, you can also check whether your guests can still
reach you now. On the other pages, the box is shorter. **You have no debt** — we did not charge anything. After payment, the page
reconnects by itself, immediately.

The **Tasks** list also says the same: your page is paused because the trial has expired, and we did not charge anything. The
“Megrendelem — fizetés” link at the end of the row takes you to the same place as the button in the red box. You have no fee to pay in this case —
the fee only arises if you continue. On the **„Állapot”** tile and in the bar on the left it then reads “Paused”.

### The “Modules” card with an expired trial

On the Overview, below the red box, a **„Modulok”** card lists which modules you used during the trial.
The card is read-only: **„Szünet alatt csak olvasható. Fizetéskor a választott csomag kapcsol vissza; amit csak
kipróbált, azt a Modulok fülön később is hozzáadhatja.”** Next to each row is a faint label:

- **„csomag · fizetéskor vissza”** — this module is in every plan, with payment it will certainly reconnect.
- **„csak a próbában volt”** — this was only given by the trial. If you select it at payment, it reconnects; if not, you can
  add it later on the Modules tab too.

### If you continue: continuing is the payment

With the “Megrendelem” or “Megrendelem — fizetés” button you reach the order panel, where you choose your plan and your
modules, and pay by bank card — the discount received with the trial, if still valid, is already counted in, and can be
used once, at this first payment. After payment:

- your page is live again immediately (if it was paused), and the selected modules stay switched on; what you only tried out
  and did not select is switched off — your settings are kept;
- your subscription starts, and your **renewal date becomes the day of payment**, not the first day of the trial: from this day
  onward everything renews every month (or year). The **Előfizetés** card on the **Modulok** tab tells you about your subscription.

### Would you like a different address? — once, free, when you continue

In the red box of the expired trial it reads: **„Tetszik a cím?”**, with your page’s current address beside it. At the end of the trial
(or if you order while the trial is still on), you may choose another citoviso.com address **once, free of charge**:

1. In the first step of the order panel opened by the “Megrendelem — fizetés” (or “Megrendelem”) button, next to the current address
   there is the label “Can be changed for free”.
2. Tap the “Megváltoztatom a címet” button, enter the desired name in the “Új cím” field, and
   press the “Ezt választom” button (with the “Marad a mostani” button you can change your mind). The panel
   signals immediately if the address is taken or cannot be used.
3. The address changes together with the payment. After that the address stays — this free change is one-time.

**The old address does not cease to exist:** it forever redirects to the new one, and no one else can get it. The letters already sent out,
the address written on your business card or in your Google profile therefore continue to work.

### How long does your page stay if you do not continue?

During the pause, nothing is lost. Your account and all your data — texts, images, settings, messages — stay for **90 days** from the
last day of the trial (Terms 1.4), and during this time you can continue at any time. After the 90 days
have passed, we delete your page, your photos and your account. At least 7 days before deletion we notify you by email; without such
a letter we do not delete. A new free trial cannot be started for the same accommodation.

## Opening the page

With the **„Oldal”** button at the top right of the page, you can at any time see how your guests see your page
— every saved change of yours shows there immediately.
